cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold your arm. Yours extends; you can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside.
